The hardest part was the Southern Link Highway; the climbs seemed to go on forever and my legs were killing me.

We stopped at a little general store at noon; when the owner heard we were cycling round the island, she cut us some watermelon.

lines.en: [Food diary] Taipei queue-for-hours ramen: got burned
Everyone online says this place is a must-eat; I queued nearly two hours to get in.
The broth turned out super salty, the noodles a bit soft, and there was just one thin slice of chashu. A real letdown.
NT$380 a bowl — terrible value. The little noodle shop in the alley next door is better.
The staff were rude too; I asked one question and got an eye-roll.
Verdict: not recommended. Don't follow the hype.
